name: EPYC 9554 DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 8B (Q4_K_M) decode
methodology: ahelpme.com measured on AMD EPYC 9554 64c Genoa, ASUS K14PA-U24-T, 12x16GB DDR5-5600 (460.8 GB/s), Gentoo kernel 6.13.7, llama-bench build 51f311e0 (b4753), --numa distribute -t 64, cache dropped, numa_balancing off. Value is the tg128 column. Batch-1 per-request, BLAS backend. Third-party measured.
